subject: reasoning
question: Town A is to the south-west of Town B. Town C is to the south of Town M. Town A is to the south-east of Town C. Town D is to the north of Town B. Town M is to the west of Town D. What is the position of Town M with respect to Town B?
solution:
Given,

 
• Town A is to the south-west of Town B. 
 
• Town C is to the south of Town M. 
 
• Town A is to the south-east of Town C.
 
• Town D is to the north of Town B. 
 
• Town M is to the west of Town D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18eec0f57fc1e3a9fce75607f008d9c0fc681e08af5a52eeec2fe626ce64377d.png] 

According to the given direction. The position of town M is to the North-West of town B.

Hence, the correct answer is **'North-West.'**
